derivation.behavior: Authoritative engine state is transactional and normalized.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go-owned SQLite schema stores downloads, requests, attempts, artifacts, ownership, checkpoints, queues, media and diagnostics.

invariants: Schema v1 creates canonical normalized tables and required indexes.
A schema newer than the engine returns ErrSchemaTooNew without downgrade.
Foreign keys reject orphan authoritative rows.
